description: Verify one loan-grain field of a CMBS loan against the SEC 10-D and ABS-EE filings. Values are TRUST-LEVEL (this trust's piece, not the whole loan). Always the CURRENT period; the receipt stamps its as-of. Pass claimed_value: you get CONFIRM / DENY / CONFLICT / UNVERIFIED plus an sf-receipt. No claim: UNVERIFIED. An unknown deal, loan or field: OUT_OF_COVERAGE.

claimed_value.description: Claim to receipt (number, or date string for paid_through_date). Required: no claim = refusal, no value.

deal.description: Deal name or alias, e.g. 'WFCM 2020-C58' or 'Wells Fargo 2020-C58'.

field.description:
The loan-grain field to verify. One of (full definitions: coverage, or the receipt's field_definition):
• beginning_balance — trust-level SCHEDULED balance at period start
• ending_balance — trust-level SCHEDULED balance at period end (not the actual/as-paid balance)
• scheduled_principal — principal applied: scheduled amortization plus unscheduled (curtailments, payoffs)
• scheduled_interest — scheduled interest, trust-level
• note_rate — current note rate in percent (not origination rate, not pool WAC)
• servicer_advances — Taxes & Insurance (escrow) advances outstanding, not P&I advances
• paid_through_date — paid-through date (a date; exact match)

loan_id.description: Loan / entity id within the deal, e.g. '25'.

name: verify_loan_field

resolved_deal.description: Deal resolution: matched, id, cik, candidates.

title: Verify a loan-grain field
